modifications: Unrigged Tripo export in 11 parts (395,328 triangles, three 2048 px textures: base colour, metal/roughness, normal map), standing in an A-pose. UV seams welded and each part decimated, the head keeping relatively more detail, to 19,988 triangles in 11 parts (remake/tools/blender-decimate.py ... parts, Blender 5.2; kept as source/egill-parts.glb). Baked by remake/tools/bake/bake-biped.js (run with bake-character.mjs): stood on the ground, scaled from 0.98 m to 1.1 m and turned to face +X, rigged with 20 humanoid bones placed from the seams between the parts, smooth skin weights, eight clips authored in code (biped-clips.js; the hop added 2026-10-17), merged into one skinned mesh with one matte single-sided material (roughness 0.65, no metalness, normal map at 0.6), base colour and normal map as 1024 px JPEG, the metal/roughness map dropped.
rig: Our bake tool (plan decision 5 changed to 'Bökunartólið, tvífætt'). Bones: root, Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, Left/Right Shoulder, UpperArm, LowerArm, Hand, Left/Right UpperLeg, LowerLeg, Foot; identity rest rotations. Clips: idle 3.2 s, walk 0.8 s (authored from the feet by two-bone IK: planted flat at 0.55 m/s, heel peel, swing), wave and waveLeft 2.4 s, point 2.0 s, sit 3.2 s (riding), lifted 1.6 s, hop 1.15 s (2026-10-17: played once, as its extras say; he crouches 65 mm, springs up 0.30 m with both arms up, his soles 0.32 m off the ground, 0.46 s in the air, and lands with a 67 mm give, starting and ending in idle's first pose; the legs by two-bone IK about each thigh's own Z axis, planted before and after; 240 keys a second).
facePass: Eyes found in the colour map by remake/tools/bake/face.js (eyes.js) and written into the GLB as extras on the skinned mesh (face.eyes: per eye its centre, frame, outline and lid and lash colours, in bind space), for the eyelids the engine builds in code (engine/eyelids.js). Geometry and textures unchanged (2026-10-15).
passes: bakeCommand, then faceCommand. Rebaked 2026-10-17 to add the hop, with both commands as they stand: the seven earlier clips came out bit for bit identical track by track (all 140 tracks, times and values), and so did the geometry, the skin weights, the inverse bind matrices, both JPEGs and the face pass's face.eyes; only the order of the two JPEGs in the binary can differ between runs, as the exporter writes them as they finish encoding. The same two commands run before the hop was added rebuilt the GLB of 2026-10-15 with the same content (qa/remake/kafli1-part1/bake/: compare-tracks.txt, glb-compare.mjs).
